segment.source: Renders one capability beside the customer sentence that proves it: heading and rich text on one side, a quotation with name, role and portrait on the other. Use it for: case-study-backed feature pages, enterprise landing pages, sections where a claim needs a witness rather than a number, reference-led sales pages. Prefer 'Feature Showcase Row' when a screenshot is the evidence, and 'Outcome Numbers' when the proof is measured rather than spoken.
